_meta.title: Social Algorithm Intelligence Dataset
_meta.description: Structured data on ranking signals, behaviors, and best practices for major social media platforms. Designed for use as context in Claude API calls.
_meta.usage_note: Inject the relevant platform object(s) as system context when calling Claude API to get algorithm-aware content recommendations.

primary.description: Percentage of viewers who watch the video to the end. The single most important signal.
Number of times users replay the video. Loops signal strong engagement.
External and in-app shares are a top positive signal.
Volume and sentiment of comments, especially early ones.
Standard engagement metric; less weighted than shares/completion.
Total absolute watch time across all viewers.
New followers gained directly from a specific video.

secondary: Text overlay presence and keyword relevance

favored_behaviors: Starting with a strong hook in the first 1-3 seconds
Creating vertical (9:16) native content
Using trending sounds and audio
Posting consistently (daily or near-daily)
Responding to comments with video replies
Using 3-5 relevant, specific hashtags (mix of niche + broad)
Creating content that encourages rewatching (looping endings)
Duet and Stitch-friendly content
Authentic, raw, behind-the-scenes content
Participating in active trends quickly
penalized_behaviors: Watermarks from other platforms (especially Reels/YouTube Shorts)
Low video quality or poor lighting
Misleading or clickbait thumbnails that disappoint

optimal_posting_frequency.notes: Volume matters significantly on TikTok. More quality posts = more distribution chances.

top_formats: Storytelling with a twist or reveal

recommended_posting_windows.notes: Adjust to your audience's local timezone. Check TikTok Analytics for your specific audience peak hours.

video_duration.notes: 7-15 seconds often achieves highest completion rates. Longer content (3-5 min) can perform well for educational niches.

technical_specs.caption_length: Up to 2200 characters; keep actionable CTAs short
technical_specs.audio: Use TikTok's native sound library for trending boost; original audio can go viral
technical_specs.thumbnail: Custom thumbnail (cover frame) selection strongly recommended

primary.description: How long users watch and whether they replay. Critical for Explore page distribution.
Shares via DM and resharing to Stories are the top engagement signal for Reels.
Indicates lasting value; saves are weighted heavily for Explore distribution.
Quality comments (not just emojis) signal meaningful engagement.
Standard signal, less influential than saves/shares.
Whether users visit the profile or follow after watching.

secondary: Presence of original audio vs. licensed music
Account authority and historical engagement rate

favored_behaviors: Filming natively on phone in vertical format (no watermarks)
Using trending Reels audio from Instagram's library
Adding captions/text overlays for silent viewing
Strong visual hook in first frame
Looping video endings
Including a clear CTA (save, share, comment prompt)
Using 3-10 relevant hashtags
Posting Reels to Feed for maximum distribution
Engaging with comments within the first hour of posting
Consistent niche content to build topical authority
penalized_behaviors: Watermarks from TikTok or other platforms
Posting political or sensitive content (reduced distribution by default)
Long periods of inactivity before posting

optimal_posting_frequency.notes: Instagram recommends 3-5 Reels/week officially. Consistency matters more than volume.

recommended_posting_windows.notes: Use Instagram Insights (Professional Account required) to see your specific audience activity.

video_duration.notes: 15-30 second Reels tend to perform best for discovery. Longer Reels (60-90s) work for educational content.

hashtags.strategy: Mix of niche-specific (small/medium volume) + 1-2 broad hashtags

technical_specs.caption_length: Up to 2200 characters; first 125 chars visible without 'more' click
technical_specs.safe_zone: Avoid placing key visuals in bottom 35% (UI overlay area)
technical_specs.thumbnail: Custom cover image recommended for Feed appearance

primary.description: The most powerful signal for Feed posts. Indicates high value content.
Sharing to Stories or DMs signals strong resonance.
Meaningful comments (length, back-and-forth) are weighted more than emoji comments.
Still relevant but less weighted than saves/shares/comments.
Content from accounts you regularly interact with is prioritized.
How many slides users swipe through in a carousel post.

secondary: User's past behavior with similar content

favored_behaviors: Publishing carousel posts (multiple slides extend engagement time)
Writing longer, value-driven captions with storytelling
Asking questions in captions to prompt comments
Using alt text for accessibility and SEO
Consistent visual aesthetic/grid theme
Tagging relevant accounts and locations
Using saves-worthy content (checklists, resources, tips)
Pinning best posts to profile top
Posting at audience peak activity times
penalized_behaviors: Posting too many posts in a short time window

optimal_posting_frequency.notes: Quality over quantity. Carousels often outperform single images 3x in reach.

recommended_posting_windows.notes: Wednesday 11:00 UTC is consistently cited as a top-performing slot globally.

carousel_slides.notes: First slide must stop the scroll; last slide should include CTA

technical_specs.file_format: JPG or PNG for images; MP4 for video

hashtags.strategy: Use keyword-rich hashtags relevant to niche; avoid oversaturated generic ones

technical_specs.caption_length: Up to 2200 characters; first 125 chars most critical
technical_specs.alt_text: Write descriptive alt text for accessibility and potential SEO benefit

primary.description: How quickly viewers swipe away. The inverse of this (retention) is the top signal.
Net positive sentiment; YouTube explicitly uses this for Shorts.
Comments indicate strong engagement and community response.
External shares signal strong content value.
New subscribers from a Short boosts the video's authority signal.

secondary: Click-through rate on thumbnail (for Shorts tab discovery)

favored_behaviors: Hooking viewers in the first 2 seconds
Creating looping content (last frame connects to first)
Using #Shorts hashtag in title or description
Maintaining a consistent upload schedule
Cross-promoting Shorts in long-form videos
Using trending audio from YouTube's audio library
Adding chapters/text overlays
Posting niche-consistent content to build topical authority
Engaging with early comments
penalized_behaviors: Watermarked content from TikTok or Reels
Videos exceeding 60 seconds in the Shorts tab
Inconsistent niche content (hurts channel topical authority)

optimal_posting_frequency.notes: YouTube Shorts benefits from high volume. Separate channel strategy for Shorts vs. long-form is sometimes recommended.

recommended_posting_windows.notes: Weekends show higher Shorts consumption. Use YouTube Studio Analytics for audience-specific data.

video_duration.notes: Videos over 60 seconds are classified as regular videos, not Shorts.

technical_specs.title_length: Up to 100 characters; include hook keyword
technical_specs.description: Up to 5000 characters; add relevant keywords and links
technical_specs.thumbnail: Auto-generated from video; custom thumbnail supported on desktop

primary.description: % of impressions converted to views. Thumbnail + title are the main CTR drivers.
Average time watched per view. Longer AVD = stronger recommendation signal.
% of video watched on average. Balances AVD for shorter vs. longer videos.
Total cumulative watch time across all viewers (volume × duration).
Net positive sentiment. YouTube uses this to evaluate audience satisfaction.
Comment volume and quality, including creator replies.
Adding to Watch Later or playlists indicates lasting value.
External shares signal strong content value.
New subscribers gained per video.

secondary: Tags (declining in weight but still relevant for search)

favored_behaviors: Crafting high-CTR thumbnails (faces, contrast, readable text)
Writing SEO-optimized titles with target keywords
Front-loading value (strong cold open before intro)
Using chapters for navigation
Creating playlists to chain related videos
Pinning a comment with key links/timestamps
Uploading custom closed captions
Consistent upload schedule (weekly or bi-weekly)
Strong end screen and card placement
Building topical authority (series, deep-dives in one niche)
penalized_behaviors: Clickbait titles/thumbnails that disappoint (high CTR + low AVD)
Long unedited intros before content begins
Misleading or sensational content (yellow dollar icon = reduced ads)

optimal_posting_frequency.notes: Quality over quantity is paramount for long-form. One excellent video per week beats three mediocre ones.

top_formats: List videos (Top 10, Best X for Y)

recommended_posting_windows.notes: Upload 2-3 hours before peak viewing time so indexing is complete. Check Studio Analytics for your audience's peak hours.

video_duration.notes: Videos over 8 minutes can include mid-roll ads (monetization signal). Ideal sweet spot is 10-15 min for engagement.

thumbnail.best_practices: High contrast, close-up face, minimal text (3-5 words max), consistent branding

technical_specs.title: 40-60 characters (front-load keyword); max 100 characters

description.first_2_lines: Critical — visible before 'Show More'; include primary keyword and hook

tags.strategy: Exact match keyword first, then variations, then broad topic tags

technical_specs.chapters: Add timestamps in description for YouTube auto-chapters (< 10 chapters recommended)
technical_specs.cards_and_end_screens: Use cards after 20% of video; add end screens in last 20 seconds

linkedin.content_type: Feed Posts (Text, Image, Video, Articles, Polls)

primary.description: Time spent reading a post without scrolling past. LinkedIn explicitly uses this as a top signal.
Thoughtful comments trigger re-distribution. Comments are weighted highest in engagement.
All reactions (Like, Love, Insightful, Curious) are weighted. 'Insightful' and 'Love' > 'Like'.
Reposts with commentary are particularly valuable.
Bookmark/save indicates lasting value.
Engagement from 1st-degree connections triggers distribution to their networks.

secondary: Post timing (first 90 minutes are critical for initial distribution)
Hashtag relevance and follower count of the hashtag

favored_behaviors: Posting native text-based content (without external links in post body)
Writing personal stories and professional insights
Using line breaks and white space for readability
Ending posts with a clear question or CTA to prompt comments
Replying to every comment within the first 60-90 minutes
Posting at consistent times 3-5 days/week
Using 3-5 relevant hashtags at the end of posts
Publishing articles for long-form evergreen content
Tagging people who are genuinely referenced (sparingly)
Using polls for high engagement and data collection
penalized_behaviors: Including external links in the post body (bury in first comment instead)
Posting and ghosting (not responding to comments)
Content flagged as spam or misinformation

optimal_posting_frequency.notes: LinkedIn penalizes posting more than once per day for most post types. Consistency over 2-3 months builds algorithmic trust.

top_formats: Text-only posts with strong hook (first 2 lines before 'see more')
Single image with insights or data
Native video (uploaded directly, not YouTube link)

recommended_posting_windows.notes: Tuesday and Wednesday 08:00-10:00 local time are consistently top performers. Avoid weekends.

text_posts.notes: Content is truncated at ~210 characters with 'see more'. Hook must appear in the first 2 lines.

native_video.notes: Add captions (auto or manual) — 70%+ of LinkedIn video is watched muted

document_carousels.notes: First slide = cover; last slide = CTA

hashtags.strategy: 1 broad industry + 1-2 niche-specific + 1 trending professional topic

articles.seo_note: LinkedIn Articles are indexed by Google; use keyword-rich title and headers

primary.description: Replies (especially back-and-forth threads) are the strongest engagement signal on X.
Quote posts drive viral distribution and signal strong resonance.
X (like Instagram) weights saves/bookmarks heavily as a 'valued content' signal.
Standard engagement signal; less weighted than replies/reposts.
For video posts, watch duration is a primary distribution signal.
Gaining followers from a specific post signals high credibility value.
X deprioritizes posts that drive traffic away from the platform.

favored_behaviors: Posting native video content (not YouTube links)
Writing threads with high information density
Ending threads with a summary or CTA tweet
Replying to your own tweets to add context
Engaging with other accounts in your niche
Posting without links in tweet body (add link in reply)
Using X Spaces for audio engagement
Writing controversial but non-violating takes to spark discussion
Using trending topics authentically
X Premium (formerly Twitter Blue) subscribers get boosted distribution
penalized_behaviors: Including external links in tweet body (moves to 'following' tab only)
Posting repetitive content or automation patterns
Using too many hashtags (1-2 max; more is considered spam)
Posting without engaging (lurking accounts see reduced reach)

optimal_posting_frequency.notes: X favors high-frequency posting. Threads count as one post. Replies to others also signal activity.

top_formats: Long-form posts (X Premium: up to 25,000 characters)

recommended_posting_windows.notes: X audience is globally distributed. Wednesday and Thursday tend to be peak engagement days.

tweet_length.notes: Shorter posts (under 100 chars) often see higher engagement rates

hashtags.strategy: Only use highly relevant trending hashtags; avoid hashtag stuffing

links.best_practice: Post the link in the first reply to the tweet, not in the tweet body, to avoid algorithmic demotion
